name: Sully.ai
tagline: A team of clinical AI agents — scribe, coder, receptionist, pharmacist.
description: Healthcare platform that deploys role-specialized AI agents to handle clinical and administrative work, from patient check-in and triage to ambient documentation, medical coding, and prescriptions. Agents integrate with Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, and 50+ other EHRs and support multiple specialties, aiming to cut clinician admin load and burnout.

modelSupport.notes: Agentic clinical workflows over LLM backends.

edge: Deploys a whole team of role-specialized clinical agents — scribe, coder, receptionist, pharmacist — across 50+ EHRs, beyond a single ambient scribe.
